initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme
initiatives.summary: JD completed £200m of share buybacks during FY26 and announced an additional £200m share buyback programme in February 2026 to complete during FY27. This reflects the company's strong cash generation and disciplined capital allocation approach.

evidence.title: Share Buyback Programme Completion and Extension

evidence.quote: the Company repurchased a total of £200m of shares during FY26. An additional £200m share buyback programme was announced in February 2026 and will complete during FY27.

initiatives.name: City Gear Store Portfolio Conversion
initiatives.summary: JD advanced the conversion of City Gear stores with the vast majority transitioning to DTLR and a smaller number to Shoe Palace. This represents a strategic simplification of the North American fascia portfolio with early performance showing encouraging results.

evidence.title: City Gear Conversion to DTLR and Shoe Palace

evidence.quote: We have successfully begun the conversion of City Gear stores, with the vast majority transitioning to DTLR and a smaller number to Shoe Palace.

initiatives.name: Global E-commerce Re-platforming Initiative
initiatives.summary: JD advanced its global e-commerce re-platforming with full roll-out to Europe and the UK to follow later in 2026. The company has already re-platformed e-commerce channels for JD and Finish Line in the US, showing tangible improvements in site speed, search and campaign tagging.

initiatives.name: Heerlen Distribution Centre Automation
initiatives.summary: JD introduced automation at its Heerlen Distribution Centre in the Netherlands to accelerate deliveries to JD stores and eventually directly to customers across Europe. This represents a major step in transforming store replenishment for JD Europe.

evidence.title: Heerlen Distribution Centre Automation Launch

initiatives.name: Human Capital Management Platform Transformation
initiatives.summary: JD invested in transforming Human Capital Management platforms, implementing Dayforce in UK/ROI and APAC markets with further launches planned across additional regions. This modernises core people processes and creates a scalable digital foundation.

evidence.title: Human Capital Management Platform Transformation
evidence.summary: JD invested in transforming Human Capital Management platforms, implementing Dayforce in UK/ROI and APAC markets with further launches planned across additional regions. This modernises core people processes and creates a scalable digital foundation.
evidence.quote: We invested in the transformation of our Human Capital Management platforms. Centred on modernising core people processes, improving the everyday experience of colleagues, and creating a scalable digital foundation, phase 1 has already delivered these benefits through the implementation of Dayforce in the UK/ROI and APAC markets, with further launches planned across additional regions over the next year.

initiatives.name: Morgan Hill Distribution Centre Expansion
initiatives.summary: JD opened a new distribution centre in Morgan Hill, California to serve Shoe Palace, JD and Finish Line fascias in the US. This facility increases the company's ability to restock stores and manage online orders in their biggest market as their first multi-fascia distribution centre.

evidence.title: Morgan Hill California Distribution Centre Opening

evidence.quote: We also opened a new distribution centre in Morgan Hill, California, to serve our Shoe Palace, JD and Finish Line fascias in the US. This facility will increase our ability to restock our stores and manage online orders in our biggest market.

initiatives.name: Hibbett Integration and Synergies
initiatives.summary: JD is on track to deliver annualised cost synergies of over US$25m across FY26 and FY27 from integration work across Hibbett and other fascias. The company is also working on efficiencies at head offices in UK and Europe, plus post-acquisition synergies in North America.

initiatives.name: AI-Enabled Performance Management Platform
initiatives.summary: JD developed an AI-enabled performance management platform with an AI-powered coaching assistant to support colleagues throughout the year. Early pilots across selected teams have demonstrated strong engagement, helping strengthen the company's ability to scale talent and build high-performance culture.

evidence.title: AI-Enabled Performance Management Platform

initiatives.name: AI-Powered Shopping and Commerce
initiatives.summary: JD announced that customers will soon be able to use AI platforms to find and buy footwear, apparel and accessories with one click, straight from top AI apps. This represents a significant digital transformation in the customer purchasing experience.

evidence.title: AI Platforms for One-Click Shopping Integration

initiatives.name: Medium-Term Plan Strategic Shift
initiatives.summary: JD announced its Medium-Term Plan Update in April 2025, shifting focus from M&A activity to driving shareholder returns. The company expects capital expenditure to trend to 3-3.5% of revenue with no material M&A opportunities in the pipeline, focusing 70% of capex in North America and Europe.

evidence.title: Medium-Term Plan Update and Capital Allocation
evidence.summary: JD announced its Medium-Term Plan Update in April 2025, shifting focus from M&A activity to driving shareholder returns. The company expects capital expenditure to trend to 3-3.5% of revenue with no material M&A opportunities in the pipeline, focusing 70% of capex in North America and Europe.
evidence.quote: In April 2025, we announced the Group's Medium-Term Plan Update. This was partly in response to lower industry growth in the sports fashion market worldwide. It also reflected that, with a period of significant supply chain and infrastructure investment and M&A activity now largely behind us, our priority and renewed focus is on driving shareholder returns.
